newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.2 bln for next week. [CORRECTED 06:30 GMT 10/5]
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.2 bln for next week. [CORRECTED 06:30 GMT 10/5]

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week are expected to total $2.2 billion in 110 sales, the lowest total since January, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.3 billion in 34 sales, with a $400 million NYC Municipal Assistance Corp deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the list.
(Corrects expected total amount for bond sales next week from $1.1 bln to $2.2 bln).
On the competitive side, 76 sales totaling $929 million are on the schedule. A $139 million Cleveland City School District, Ohio, deal on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional 11 sales totaling $684 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds next week depending on market conditions.
